info.title: LessonBuddy Universal API
info.description: Public API for Big Blue Swim School's LessonBuddy platform, covering documented campaign, family, inventory, and location endpoints.

post.description: Creates a new lead in LessonBuddy.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

locationId.description: LessonBuddy location ID for the lead.

firstName.description: Lead first name. At least one of first name or last name is required by LessonBuddy.

lastName.description: Lead last name. At least one of first name or last name is required by LessonBuddy.

emailAddress.description: Lead email address. At least one contact method, email or cell phone, is required by LessonBuddy.

cellPhone.description: Lead cell phone. At least one contact method, email or cell phone, is required by LessonBuddy.

marketingOptIn.description: Whether the customer consented to marketing opt-in.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.
